meta.title: HeatNet Network Reading Path
meta.subtitle: Fresh Wi-Fi radio sampling and distinct HTTPS/TCP and ICMP measurements on Android

messages.label: Measure at the selected room point (x, y)
messages.note: The network monitor captures the active default Network and Wi-Fi/mobile transport; every probe reuses that handle.

messages.label: Check fine location; register fresh Wi-Fi callback
messages.note: FLAG_INCLUDE_LOCATION_INFO and the captured Network handle gate this read; without fine location it is blocked.

messages.label: Fresh RSSI, Rx link speed, frequency + BSSID
messages.note: Frequency maps to band/channel. Redacted fields stay null, so the reading is partial.

messages.label: Run download, upload, then latency probes
HTTPS over TCP/IP via Wi-Fi AP or cellular RAN + ISP
messages.note: Socket and DNS use the captured Network. HTTP responses return status, bytes and timing; goodput is Internet throughput, not raw link capacity.

messages.label: ICMP Echo via captured interface and IP
messages.note: ping -I selects the captured Network route; echo replies or timeouts produce the result.

messages.label: ICMP loss from echo results; unavailable if probe cannot run
If ICMP has no replies and HTTP worked: fallback probes
Failed-request rate, method = HTTP
messages.note: Application-probe failures, not raw packet drops; without HTTP reachability the result is unavailable.

messages.label: Save metrics, loss method, coordinates + demo flag; refresh map
messages.note: Room stores source provenance. Heatmap interpolation estimates unsampled room points.
